capabilities: Embed local video, audio, and image files into notes
Generate media code blocks from a selected file path
Insert clickable timestamps that seek a playing video
Support multiple media formats such as MP4 and MP3
problem: Embedding local media and creating timestamps that seek a video require writing embed code manually; the plugin automates this from the right-click menu.
summary: Media embedding plugin that inserts local video, audio, and image files into notes as code blocks with clickable playback timestamps.
